'''''Chiller''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The corvette, along with the ''[[Glaser]]'', was part of a Rebel strike force attacking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Laantis]]'' while it was receiving a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine from the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Rasvin]]''. The corvette, along with the rest of the Rebels, was destroyed in the battle.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Chiller'', along with a number of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and the ''Glaser'', are purple in the CMD. However, there is no indication of who they belong to other than the Rebels.
